g.title: A
g.text: SmartSpare — microservice-ready modular monolith on Azure

g.title: cluster_app
g.text: Azure App Service (Linux container) — one deployable

g.title: cluster_mod
g.text: — each: Domain/ · Features/<UseCase>/ · Infrastructure/ (DbContext, migrations) + Contracts

g.title: cluster_db
g.text: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server 17
— one database, schemas owned by modules (ADR 0011)

g.title: users
g.text: Brand manager · Service engineer · Warehouse keeper

g.title: web
g.text: typed HTTP clients per module · SmartSpare.ApiContracts

g.title: host
g.text: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal APIs · OpenAPI · ProblemDetails (SS1xx–SS4xx)
HttpOnly SameSite cookie + antiforgery · claims-based policies

g.title: pipe
g.text: own ICommandHandler / IQueryHandler instead of MediatR
decorators: logging → validation (FluentValidation) → transaction (unit of work)

g.title: bus
g.text: integration events written in the module's transaction,
dispatched with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, idempotent consumers
(in-process now; Azure Service Bus after a split)

g.title: db
g.text: ref · util · audit (Platform) │ iam │ catalog · inventory · raw · staging │ fleet │ procurement │ forecast │ mart
no FKs, JOINs or transactions across modules · outbox_message / inbox_message and __ef_migrations_history per module
triggers · functions · views · materialised views · roles and grants (SQL parts in db/sql/<module>)

g.title: jobs
g.text: mart refresh · reservation expiry · audit purge · ML training

g.title: mig
g.text: EF Core migration bundle per module context

g.title: runner
g.text: bootstrap + EF migrations in ModuleCatalog order
